lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.title: Transfer challenge: reading and writing numerical expressions

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: The example is from a different context than the problems below.

items.prompt: Describe 5 × (12 + 3) in words without evaluating it.

steps: The parentheses show that 12 and 3 are added first.
workedSolution.answer: Add 12 and 3, then multiply the sum by 5.

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: Let E represent 4530 + 6712. Without evaluating, how does 8 × (4530 + 6712) compare with E?
A supply cart has 89 boxes with 101 markers in each box and 20 loose markers. Which expression represents the total number of markers?
A team packs 45 crates with 50 bottles in each crate, adds 25 loose bottles, and then uses 46 bottles. How many bottles remain?
In 2519788, how does the value of the 8 in the tens place compare with the value of the 8 in the ones place?
Round each number to the nearest thousand to estimate 745500 - 305500.

sections.title: Extension and challenge
sections.directions: These are meant to be hard. Show the reasoning even if you do not finish.

items.prompt: Round 850 to the nearest hundred and 75 to the nearest ten, then multiply to estimate the product.
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.prompt: A student says 29 × 75 = 2175. Round each number to the nearest ten. Which choice correctly checks the claim?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.prompt: A student evaluates 4 × [18 + (11 - 8)] + 23: “They multiply 4 by 18 first, then finish the calculation, so the value is 98.” Which statement best identifies the error?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.
